2. Editor opens IN PLACE as a sibling div below the row's compact stack inside the same <li> (the #222 same-frame idiom — no drawer/dialog/overlay; SectionPicker's dropdown is the WRONG precedent). One editor open at a time (per-row scalar, the page's arm-state precedent). Collapse on save success; close-without-save creates nothing.
3. Four fields, #239 idiom (wrapping <label> whose visible <span> IS the sole accessible name — no aria-label doubling): roster-record-name (text, required, et label Pärisnimi), roster-record-phone (type=tel, et Telefon), roster-record-email (type=email, et E-post), roster-record-birthdate (NATIVE date input per #207 — stays as built, browser-locale rendering is correct), et Sünnikuupäev. ## Prefill (first open, no-record only) — R4
4. NAME prefill uses the ROSTER'S OWN domain-or-public scan (toRosterRow's inline resolution — i.e. prefill with row.name, exactly 'the name the roster shows'), NOT resolveField — resolveField prefers private-tier first and would promote a private-only profile name into a domain-shared field (the #28/#58 leak class rosterData.ts documents; interpretation reported to PO, override window open). EMAIL prefill = resolveField(profiles,'email') as contracted (matches the roster's email column). Phone + date of birth start EMPTY. No profile name to copy → field opens empty, no placeholder-as-value (resolveField returns '' — pinned). Once a record EXISTS: editor shows the RECORD only — never re-prefill, never merge, never overwrite a deliberately-cleared field (pin: record with empty phone reopens empty even though... phone has no profile source; pin the name case: record name differs from profile name → record name shown).
## Wire (governed surface)
5. READ (check-then-create + editor load): ONE query entity?_type.string=admin_member_record&person.reference={personId}&props=name,phone,email,birthdate&limit=10 against cfg.db (db-scoped per call — per-collective isolation by construction; the record's required database parent + the single-collective-per-db invariant make _parent filtering redundant, matching the listActiveMembers sibling pattern). 0 results → create path; 1 → update path; >1 → DAMAGED DATA: surface loudly (role=alert naming the member, new key ×4), refuse to guess, NO writes, NO self-repair (#264 ruling).
6. CREATE (lazy, first save): POST entity with [{type:'_type',reference:resolveTypeId(cfg,'admin_member_record')},{type:'_parent',reference:dbEntityId},{type:'_sharing',string:'domain'},{type:'person',reference:personId},{type:'name',string},...optional fields only when non-empty]. Explicit entity-level _sharing — the per-PROPERTY tiers are the provisioned prop-defs' (schema-level, #265) — state this mechanics note in a code comment so 'sharing explicit on every property' reads correctly. Full-shape toEqual pin + negative twin (payload missing _sharing fails).
7. UPDATE: replaceEntityProperty per changed field (atomic overwrite — no bare-POST append, no property DELETEs on the normal path). birthdate wire: the date input's YYYY-MM-DD becomes {type:'birthdate',datetime:'<date>T00:00:00.000Z'} (UTC-midnight anchor); RENDER/RE-EDIT reads the stored string's date part via split('T')[0] — NEVER new Date() local-time getters (the #207 no-day-shift idiom, event-detail precedent). Pin the round-trip: save 1990-03-15, reopen shows 1990-03-15 regardless of TZ (deterministic spec with a non-UTC TZ fixture).
8. SAVES server-confirmed, never optimistic: save control disabled in flight; reflect only after confirmation; generation captured per the #259 pattern (AFTER triggering, checked before every state write); collective switch mid-edit closes/discards the editor (reset({isSwitch}) entries for ALL new state — pin); success → collapse + announce via a NEW fifth sr-only role=status region roster-member-record-status (mounted-from-first-render, imperative text, the four siblings' idiom); FAILURE TELLS THE TRUTH: message states nothing was saved, typed values STAY in the form (pin), select... form re-enabled. Partial-failure (multi-field update where field 2 fails): say exactly what landed (#253 class) — pin with a deterministic two-field-one-fails spec.
## Privacy fences
9. rosterData.ts and every member-visible path fetch NOTHING new (its docstring fence stays true — pin the existing props= negative assertion still passes and add one for the roster load never requesting admin_member_record). Error messages/logs: STATIC strings + status codes only — NEVER interpolated field values (the house convention; pin: the thrown error/console output on a failed save contains no field value).
10. Editor fields absent from the DOM for non-admins (whole-block gating — not hidden/disabled).

All new/changed specs must FAIL against the branch base (post-#267 tree); run and REPORT the failing output verbatim. Stage explicitly by path.

tasks.commitBody: Slice 2 of #265: the admin's member-data editor, in-row on the roster. Pencil per member row (admin-only, fail-closed, a11y-named per member) opening a same-frame editor below the row: Pärisnimi (required) / Telefon / E-post / Sünnikuupäev (native date input; datetime-stored via UTC-midnight anchor, date-only rendered via split('T') — no timezone day-shift). Lazy create on first save with explicit _sharing; first-open-only prefill (name from the roster's own domain-or-public resolution — not resolveField, whose private-first ordering would promote a private-only name into the domain field; email via resolveField as the roster's email column does); record-wins thereafter. One-record invariant check-then-create; >1 surfaces loudly, no self-repair. Server-confirmed truthful saves keeping typed values; partial failures state exactly what landed; fifth sr-only status region; #259 generation guards + switch-reset. Member-visible paths fetch nothing new; no field value reaches an error message or log. STATED CHOICES: <GREEN agent fills the six stated choices as sentences>.
